steps.body: Counting can walk backward too: 20, 19, 18, 17. Each step is one less.
steps.narration: Counting can walk backward too: 20, 19, 18, 17. Each step is one less.

widget.prompt: Start at 20 and count back 4. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 5 back. Count just 4 down from 20 to land on 16.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 20 and count back 4: you land on 16.

predict.prompt: Counting BACK 4 from 20 — which way do the numbers go?
predict.reveal: Counting back walks DOWN the number line: 20 back 4 lands on 16. 24 is what counting FORWARD 4 gives — right arithmetic, wrong direction.
